faq.answer: The last date is 9 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in VJTI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 vacancies: 1 Head Chef, 1 Mess Manager, 3 Mess Workers.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for VJTI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 9 December 2026. There is no online form.

faq.answer: The age limit is below 50 years (as on last date of application).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: ₹. 40,000 to ₹. 50,000 (Consolidated) for Head Chef, ₹. 40,000 to ₹. 50,000 (Consolidated) for Mess Manager, ₹. 16,000 to ₹. 18,000 (Consolidated) for Mess Workers.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Head Chef: Diploma / Certificate in food production / catering with minimum five years of cooking experience; Mess Manager: Degree or Diploma in Hotel Management / Catering Technology with minimum five years of experience; Mess Workers: must be able to read and write in Marathi. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Head Chef and Mess Manager: candidate should be male, of Indian origin. Head Chef: expertise in preparing hygienic, tasty and wholesome everyday Indian meals. Mess Workers: must be able to read and write in Marathi.

faq.answer: Interview. List of eligible candidates and date of interview will be published later on VJTI website. Original educational and experience certificates to be produced at the interview.

faq.answer: Purely contractual, initially for 11 months. Head Chef: may be extended based on performance and requirement for maximum 03 years. Mess Manager and Mess Workers: may be extended based on performance and requirement for another year.
